label: cor:jet-prolongation-C
title: Archimedean realisation of jet prolongation
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, \varTheta, G, \mathcal{S}) be an archimedean quantum observable universe (\mathbb{C}-quantum observable universe) equipped with an instanton connection A on the principal bundle P and a metric g on \mathcal{S}. We denote the total space of \mathcal{S} by \widetilde{M} = \mathcal{S}. Let P' be the frame bundle and \mathcal{S}' the bundle of orthonormal frames of the first jet bundle J^1 \mathcal{S}. The data (A, g) uniquely determines a connection A' on P' such that (\mathbf{C}, \tilde\varTheta, G, \mathcal{S}') structurally forms an archimedean quantum observable universe.

Dimension preservation is one of the defining conditions of a jet prolongation, not a consequence of the others: prolonged and base are independent data, so nothing forces their CR dimensions to agree except the condition itself. The formal backing QOU.Torsion.jet_prolongation_C returns that condition under a readable name — the Mathlib accessor idiom — and derives nothing. Read the statement as fixing what a prolongation is, not as a corollary of the construction.
